news.contents: Daniel Jones has been released by the Indianapolis Colts according to Adam Schefter.

news.contents: Indianapolis Colts quarterback Daniel Jones faces questions about his starting job following Thursday's 26-3 loss to Houston. Jones completed 12 of 27 passes for 144 yards and threw an interception before Anthony Richardson Sr. entered late in the fourth quarter. When asked whether Jones would remain the starter, head coach Shane Steichen said, "We'll evaluate everything," according to Mike Florio of Pro Football Talk. news.contents: The Minnesota Vikings will face the San Francisco 49ers' stout run defense in Week 11, presenting a challenge for running back Aaron Jones Sr. The veteran put together a solid week on limited touches last time out, rushing 11 times for 47 yards and a touchdown while adding one catch in a continued split with fellow running back Jordan Mason. The veteran had two carries for four yards and a rushing touchdown, adding three catches on four targets and a receiving touchdown against the Carolina Panthers in Week 10. news.analysis: As expected, Kelce's ankle injury isn't serious right now and won't prevent him from playing on Sunday. He may be a decent fantasy option in PPR formats this week, although we haven't seen a high week-to-week ceiling for him so far this season.
news.contents: Travis Kelce (ankle) will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
news.title: Travis Kelce (ankle) good to go for Sunday

news.contents: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce caught two passes for 30 yards in last week's 35-13 win over the Atlanta Falcons. Rashee Rice led the way with 82 yards and newly acquired Josh Downs played limited snaps in his Chiefs debut last week but had four catches for 53 yards and a touchdown in the victory. news.analysis: Reed was able to participate in Wednesday's practice in a limited fashion. That's a good sign for his Week 11 availability, but he still hasn't been officially cleared to play, so we won't know more until sometime later in the week.
news.contents: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) limited Wednesday

news.analysis: Cashman was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday, which means that he is almost certainly going to be fully cleared to play for Week 11. That's great news for Minnesota's defense ahead of a challenging matchup against the 49ers.
news.contents: Blake Cashman (concussion) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
news.title: Blake Cashman (concussion) practices in full Wednesday

news.analysis: Milton started in the Eagles' loss to the Giants before their bye. He'll continue to add more mobility as a rusher to go along with an inconsistent arm.
news.contents: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni announced Joe Milton will start in Week 11 against the Steelers.
news.title: Joe Milton III to remain Eagles starter in Week 11

news.contents: Following a bye week, quarterback Joe Milton III will make his second start for the Philadelphia Eagles in an intrastate matchup with the Pittsburgh Steelers in Week 11. In his first career start against the New York Giants in Week 9, Milton completed 18 out of 34 passes (52.9%) for 169 yards, with zero touchdowns and zero interceptions. news.title: Joe Milton III Hopes to Make the Most of Opportunity

news.analysis: "He's 100% healthy right now, in shape, and working out full force," Drew Rosenhaus, Aiyuk's agent, told Dianna Russini. He'll look to sign with another team when the 49ers release him.
news.contents: Brandon Aiyuk has reportedly passed the 49ers' physical.
news.title: Brandon Aiyuk passes 49ers physical

news.contents: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk remains under contract nine days after the NFL reinstated him from the reserve/left squad list. Pro Football Talk expects the 49ers to wait until next week if they release him. His exemption from the 53-man roster expires Monday, Nov. 23, one day after San Francisco plays the Minnesota Vikings in Mexico City. news.title: 49ers Unlikely to Cut Brandon Aiyuk Before Roster Exemption Expires

news.analysis: Bland is not going to be available to play on Sunday. He recently suffered an ankle injury and is going to miss some time as a result, although it's unclear if he will miss more time beyond this game. Dallas' already-weak secondary will be operating at less than full strength with him out.
news.contents: DaRon Bland (ankle) is unavailable for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
news.title: DaRon Bland (ankle) unavailable for Sunday

news.analysis: Adams continues to recover from hamstring surgery, but has progressed enough to potentially return sooner than later for a shorthanded Rams passing attack. The veteran wideout would slide into a WR1 role for head coach Sean McVay with Puka Nacua potentially out for the remainder of the season upon his return.
news.contents: Davante Adams (hamstring) could return in Week 13 for the Los Angeles Rams according to Michael J. Duarte.
news.title: Davante Adams (hamstring) could return Week 13

Duarte of The California Post that wide receiver Davante Adams (hamstring) could return in Week 13 against the Kansas City Chiefs. "Don't think he's ready quite yet. There is a possibility he'll be ready the game after the Packers," McVay said.
